intent.summary: Manual-only fix (never auto-executed; zero gos auto run invocations inside the fix window): the stage-dispatch redesign stranded the registered write channel on BUILD waves — non-wave agent stages (INTENT/THINK/PLAN/REVIEW) issue the commit grant but compose without scratch/ack equipage (loop.cjs waveEquipage gating), so in-sandbox gos commit <stage> deterministically refuses no-entry via admitDirect against the sandbox-masked store registry. Fix: ship the per-spawn scratch/ack channel (and manifest equipage as consistency demands) for every work spawn, with a regression test reproducing the sandboxed no-entry refusal for a non-wave stage. Store dir ~/.local/share/gos/85af56a090a78924 is live dogfood evidence — never delete, reset, or overwrite it; any fixture store must be XDG-overridden inside tests.
